statement: Durudhara Yoga (the Moon flanked by planets in both the 2nd and 12th houses from it) is traditionally read as carrying the compounded benefits of Sunapha and Anapha together — wealth, comfort, and a generally fortunate, well-supported life.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
